description: Authoritative M9 texture manifest. Maps every BlockType to its per-face source PNGs (top/side/bottom). Paths are relative to the repository root and use forward slashes. A null face means no source texture is available for that face; consumers must skip null entries. Any non-null path that is missing on disk is a hard error for the atlas generator (scripts/pack_textures.py).

unavailable.WATER: No water source texture exists under voxel_textures/blocks/. A texture must be added before WATER can be rendered.
